name: bunrdkafka-native
$comment1: The librdkafka vcpkg port has NO 'lz4' feature (librdkafka bundles lz4 internally); valid features are curl/sasl/ssl/zlib/zstd.
$comment2: Version skew: the windows-2022 runner ships a vcpkg snapshot whose librdkafka port may lag the tag pinned in ../librdkafka.version (e.g. 2.14.2 vs 2.15.0). TODO(M7): unify Windows onto FetchContent or pin a vcpkg builtin-baseline — decide before the first release.
